_about: The per-game list (Sprint 17, s17-chk1; s19-checks-2, the check sort's G5: no opt-ins). Each game's family and the station ids its flows play, which the contract's report groups its pages by (lib/contract-screen.mjs gameOf: 'judged N of M' per game); stages: the stage kinds contract-91 judges, as regular expressions on the stage key; hosts: entries that are not games (the clinic). It holds no check field: every contract check judges every game from what is on screen and the shared notes (the old fields help, controlCalls, slowAtGreen, onceEach, cardLight, s14Taps, decoys and cardWritten are gone: lib/contract-chai.mjs fieldsLeft must be empty). Proof: node --test build/sandbox/contract-chai.test.mjs.
